evidence: Implements Cap'n Proto IPC wrappers, libmultiprocess subtree integration, and executables for bitcoin-node, bitcoin-wallet, and bitcoin-gui.
rationale: This PR delivers the core architecture for the process separation project (#28722), enabling isolated bitcoin-node, bitcoin-wallet, and bitcoin-gui processes. Completing this foundational IPC layer is critical to unblocking out-of-process node and wallet execution (#19460, #19461).
